title: Hezekiah Reigns and Assyria Invades

questions.question: Who was the son of Ahaz who reigned in Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:1 (ESV): "...Hezekiah the son of Ahaz, king of Judah, began to reign."

questions.question: How is Hezekiah described in relation to trusting God?
options: He trusted in the LORD, so that there was none like him among all the kings of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: He trusted in the LORD, so that there was none like him among all the kings of Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:5 (ESV): "He trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel, so that there was none like him among all the kings of Judah..."

questions.question: What did Hezekiah do to the bronze serpent Moses had made?
options: He broke it in pieces because people burned incense to it
He put it in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: He broke it in pieces because people burned incense to it
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:4 (ESV): "...and he broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, for until those days... the people of Israel had made offerings to it..."

questions.question: Who invaded Judah in the fourteenth year of Hezekiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:13 (ESV): "In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah..."

questions.question: What officials did the King of Assyria send to Jerusalem?
options: The Tartan, the Rab-saris, and the Rabshakeh
questions.correctAnswer: The Tartan, the Rab-saris, and the Rabshakeh
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:17 (ESV): "And the king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rab-saris, and the Rabshakeh..."

questions.question: What did Hezekiah give Sennacherib to make him withdraw?
options: All the silver in the temple and palace, and gold from the doors
questions.correctAnswer: All the silver in the temple and palace, and gold from the doors
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:15-16 (ESV): "And Hezekiah gave him all the silver... At that time Hezekiah stripped the gold from the doors..."

questions.question: What name was the bronze serpent called?
What argument did the Rabshakeh use to demoralize the people?
options: That the LORD told Assyria to destroy the land
That they should surrender for money
questions.correctAnswer: That the LORD told Assyria to destroy the land
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:25 (ESV): "Moreover, is it without the LORD that I have come up against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land and destroy it."

questions.question: What language did the Jewish officials ask the Rabshakeh to speak?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:26 (ESV): "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it..."

questions.question: What land did the Rabshakeh promise to take them to?
options: A land like your own land
questions.correctAnswer: A land like your own land
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:32 (ESV): "until I come and take you away to a land like your own land..."

questions.question: How much silver and gold was imposed on Hezekiah?
options: 300 talents of silver and 30 talents of gold
questions.correctAnswer: 300 talents of silver and 30 talents of gold
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:14 (ESV): "...required of Hezekiah... three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold."

questions.question: Did the people answer the Rabshakeh?
options: No, for the king's command was, "Do not answer him."
questions.correctAnswer: No, for the king's command was, "Do not answer him."
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:36 (ESV): "But the people were silent and answered him not a word, for the king's command was, 'Do not answer him.'"

questions.question: Who did Hezekiah rebel against?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:7 (ESV): "He rebelled against the king of Assyria and would not serve him."

questions.question: Where did the Rabshakeh stand to speak?
options: By the conduit of the upper pool
questions.correctAnswer: By the conduit of the upper pool
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:17 (ESV): "...And when they arrived, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool..."

questions.question: Who came out to meet the Assyrian officials?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 18:18 (ESV): "...there came out to them Eliakim... and Shebna... and Joah..."

key_verse_text: He trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel, so that there was none like him among all the kings of Judah after him, nor among those who were before him. (ESV)
